TITLE_DIALOG_PRIVACY_POLICY_TEXT:
Privacy Policy

Established: August 19, 2011
Last revised: January 29, 2019

Introduction

Aiming Inc. ("the Company") complies with laws and regulations concerning personal information and handles information about its users appropriately.

1. Information the Company Collects

■ Information related to registering for our services
When users register for the Company's services, they may be asked to provide the following information:
(1) A name identifying the user (full name, username, nickname, etc.)
(2) Email address
(3) Date of birth
(4) Gender
(5) Other user information specified by the Company

■ Device information
When users use the Company's services and websites, the Company may collect the following information:
(1) Device identifiers
(2) IP address
(3) Device type and model name
(4) OS and OS version
(5) Other information the user has agreed to provide

■ Location information
To provide services that require location information, the Company may collect the location of the user's device.

■ Payment information
When users purchase licenses to use virtual currency or virtual items within the Company's services, the Company may obtain billing and payment information provided to third-party payment service providers (including but not limited to Apple Inc. and Google LLC).

■ Information related to customer support
When users receive customer support from the Company, the Company may collect and store the following information:
(1) Contact information (usually, but not limited to, an email address)
(2) Information about the user's use of the services
(3) User ID
(4) Support correspondence and the information it contains

■ Information about use of the services
When users use the Company's services, the Company may collect and store information provided directly to the Company and information about how the services are used.
The Company may also record and store users' interactions with other users on its services and the information those interactions contain.

■ Information collected using cookies and similar technologies
When users access the Company's services or websites, the Company may use cookies and similar technologies to collect information about the user's browser and environment and about how the services and websites are used.
Similar technologies may also be used in parts of our advertising systems.

■ Information from access analytics
To understand how its services and websites are used, the Company uses Google Analytics, an access analytics service provided by Google.
For details on the data Google Analytics collects and how it is processed, please see Google's website.
https://www.google.com/intl/ja/policies/privacy/partners/

■ Information obtained through integration with external services
The Company may obtain the user's ID for external services they use, as well as other information the user has allowed to be disclosed to partners through that service's privacy settings.

2. Use of Collected Information

The Company uses the information it collects for the following purposes:
(1) Providing the Company's services
(2) Billing and charge calculation
(3) Identity verification and authentication
(4) Conducting surveys, sweepstakes, and campaigns
(5) Marketing research, statistics, and analysis
(6) Developing, providing, maintaining, fixing bugs in, and improving the quality of the Company's services, websites, content, and advertising
(7) Sending important notices, such as changes to the Company's terms, conditions, and policies
(8) Delivering advertisements and measuring their results
(9) Providing technical support and responding to user inquiries
(10) Developing and providing targeted advertising for products or services of the Company or third parties
(11) Preventing fraudulent or potentially illegal activity
(12) Other purposes of use specified for each of the Company's services

3. Security of Collected Information

The Company takes necessary and appropriate measures to prevent the leakage, loss, or damage of the personal information it handles and to otherwise keep that personal information secure.

4. Sharing and Disclosure of Collected Information to Third Parties

The Company will not disclose users' personal information to third parties except in the following cases:
(1) When the Company discloses information collected to understand usage trends of the service, as statistical data that cannot identify individuals, to third parties such as potential partner companies or advertisers
(2) When the user has separately and explicitly consented to the disclosure
(3) When disclosure or sharing is deemed necessary to provide products or services the user has requested
(4) When providing user information to third parties with which the Company has a partnership or cooperative relationship is necessary to provide the service
(5) When provided to the Company's contractors to the extent necessary to carry out the Company's business
(6) When provided to a contractor or transferee due to outsourcing of service operations, business transfer, or similar reasons
(7) When the Company receives a formal legal inquiry from a court, the police, or another public authority
(8) When there is an imminent danger to a person's life, body, or property and there is an urgent need to disclose
(9) When disclosure of a user's personal information is necessary to protect the Company's rights or property due to that user's violation of the terms
(10) Any other case the Company, at its discretion, deems necessary to maintain the service

5. Disclosure and Correction of Personal Information

If a person requests disclosure of their own personal information, the Company will disclose it promptly.
However, the Company will not comply if it cannot confirm the requester's identity.
If personal information contains errors and the person requests its correction, addition, or deletion, the Company will investigate and promptly respond to the request.
However, the Company will not comply if it cannot confirm the requester's identity.
For such requests or other inquiries about the Company's handling of personal information, please contact us through our inquiry form.

6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

The contents of this Privacy Policy may change.
Unless the Company specifies otherwise, the revised Privacy Policy takes effect when it is posted on this site.
